articles.title: This Robot Speaks Ojibwe — and a Kid Built It!
articles.summary: A 12-year-old built a shoulder robot that teaches his endangered Native language. Named Sabe (Bigfoot), it answers questions like “What’s bear?” in Anishinaabemowin. Only about 10,000 people still speak it in the U.S.

articles.title: UK’s New Prime Minister Says He’ll Speak Up to Trump
articles.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham won’t promise to always agree with President Trump. He says he’ll “call things as they develop” and do what’s right for Britain. He also ruled out an early election before 2029.

articles.title: Open, Closed, or Open-Weight? The Secret Labels of AI
articles.summary: AI models have labels like “open” or “closed,” but it’s not about personality. It’s about whether their recipe (code and data) is public. Some, like Meta’s LLaMa, are called “open-weight” because they share only part of the recipe.
